editorial_decisions: Kept all 26 supplied catalogue products and added six original-site ranges, for 32 total entries.
Restored a dedicated /services page, including direct/static visits, navigation and sitemap entry; removed its previous redirect to /products.
The old home page describes NFC with generic proximity copy. NFC and 125 kHz proximity use cases are now separate.
The old services page labels the printer-ribbon entry Card Holders. It is now Printer ribbons & consumables.
The old 1K/4K smart-card entry conflicts with its listed 125 kHz frequency. MIFARE Classic 1K/4K uses 13.56 MHz, verified against NXP; 125 kHz remains on proximity cards.

ISO certification is an original company claim, not independently verified from a certificate. The old narrative says 16+ years while its counter says 15+. Retained the narrative, without inventing a founding year.

Did not replicate template filler, spelling mistakes, universal reader-compatibility promises, exclusivity/biggest/best superlatives, or the unsubstantiated 100% satisfaction counter. Manufacturing strengths and customer-care intent are preserved.
Surface-quality wording describes inspection criteria rather than promising that a card can never be scratched or damaged.
The original product PDF is kept unchanged as supplied; restored website-only products appear in the online catalogue.
